speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for coming in. To understand the cause of your fatigue, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph node, have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as constipation, diarrhea, or a feeling of incomplete evacuation?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Those "B" symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss) combined with supraclavicular lymphadenopathy and abdominal pain are highly concerning for a malignancy, possibly involving the gastrointestinal tract or lymphoma. Have you experienced any loss of appetite, early satiety, or visible blood in your stool? REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, CMP, and LDH.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete Blood Count: WBC Elevated, Hemoglobin Slightly Decreased, Platelets Normal; Lactate Dehydrogenase Elevated

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: The blood work back shows an elevated white blood cell count with lymphocytosis and a significantly high LDH level. Given the supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, weight loss, and abdominal pain, do you have a history of smoking or any recent exposure to secondhand smoke? REQUEST IMAGES: Chest CT and Abdominal Pelvic CT.

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Doctor
text: The tightening of your clothes and early satiety suggest significant abdominal mass effect. Given the lymphocytosis, high LDH, and supraclavicular nodes, are there any lumps under your skin or on your neck that you can feel? REQUEST TEST: ESR, CRP.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma with gastrointestinal involvement. The combination of B-symptoms, supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, abdominal mass effect (early satiety), lymphocytosis, markedly elevated LDH, and elevated inflammatory markers is classic for this presentation.
